text: DreamLux ERP
Non-Technical QA Blackbox Test Plan
COMPREHENSIVE VERIFICATION PROTOCOL

Welcome to the QA Test Plan. This guide is written for non-technical QA testers to verify the DreamLux ERP application through the user interface. It covers the whole project at a blackbox level: log in, click through the app, and record whether the visible behavior matches the expected result.
1. Test Credentials
Use these default credentials to log in and verify permission boundaries:
2. Smoke Test Before Any Release
3. Release / PR Coverage Map
Use this table to decide which blackbox suites matter most after a release. A release can touch more than one area, so run the listed suites plus the smoke test.
4. Test Suites (Verification Tables)
Test Suite A: Reference Data & Settings (New)
Verify operational reference data CRUD features.
Test Suite B: Event Lifecycle, Proposals & Scheduling
Verify event proposals, creation, workflows, and resource assignments.
Test Suite C: Inventory & Assets
Verify assets storage, stock counts, low-stock alerts, and location reconciliation.
Test Suite D: Finance & Payroll
Verify salary levels, expense review, auto-labor generation, and profit calculations.
Test Suite E: Users, Roles & Permissions
Verify that access control is understandable and cannot be bypassed through the UI.
Test Suite F: Reports, Exports & Printing
Verify pages that produce downloadable or printable business records.
Test Suite G: Search, Filters & Pagination
Verify list pages work at realistic business scale.
Test Suite H: Error Handling & Data Safety
Verify common mistakes are handled clearly.
Test Suite I: Live Notifications, Auditing, and Offline Shell
Verify real-time mutations, PWA offline behavior, security postures, and unified trash views.
Test Suite J: UI Polish, Aesthetics & Accessibility (New)
Verify gold contrast compliance, custom border radius tokens, light mode readability, and form validation highlights.
5. UI Aesthetics & Responsiveness Checklist
Verify these premium design rules on any device or viewport:
High Contrast: Text must be easily readable on dark and light backdrops. Accents use elegant luxury gold (#D4AF37).
Monospace Metrics: Large numbers and financial figures use clean monospace fonts to prevent shifting layout jitter.
No Overlaps: Shrink the browser width down to 320px (mobile layout). The layout must collapse cleanly into a single vertical column. The sidebar must hide under a hamburger drawer or float button.
Amharic Translation: Toggle language to Amharic. Confirm labels for Reference Data sections update correctly.

Permission-aware UX polish, route guards, backend access hardening, Playwright portability.
Forbidden pages must be clean; hidden buttons must not flash; drivers must not see finance/admin actions.
Core event lifecycle closeout and read-permission reconciliation.
Event detail/workspace should open for allowed roles; completed/locked event behavior must remain intact.
Frontend RBAC audit across proposals, profit reports, payroll, event types, and trash screens.
Read-only users may view allowed data but must not see write/delete/restore buttons.
Reference Data setup pages and sidebar grouping.
Departments, Positions, and Offices must sit under Reference Data; delete impact warnings must block active-use records.
Proposal creator attribution and test isolation fixes.
Proposal queue and detail must show Proposed By; deleted/missing users must show Unknown user, not crash.
Seeded admin and user credential parity.
Smoke, Users/Roles, Events, Inventory, Finance, Driver BOLA.
admin, driver, eventmgr, and inventory_user must log in with Password123; driver must remain mapped to Selam Bekele and blocked from unrelated driver actions.
Soft-deleted events/assets must be restorable from the trash pages; restore respects role permissions.
Notification center, permission-safe delivery, live toast notifications.
Mutation actions (creation, deletion, updates) must fire beautiful premium toasts; notifications load in real-time.
Record activity timeline drawer and visual audit logs.
Actions should be audited and visible in the activity timeline log drawers on relevant pages.
HR Dashboard, click-to-edit drawer, exception lists.
Workforce overview shows metric summaries; list exceptions (Missing Bank/ID/Contract) open side drawers to fix.
Settings / Security shows a plain-language summary of access controls, dynamic safety checks, and SSL/database indicators.
PWA installability, service worker caching, and offline shell.
Bottom PWA banner shows on first launch; offline simulated mode loads a clean local fallback shell.
Custom role manager changes preview, warning validation popups.
Diff pane preview appears for role modification changes; dangerous changes prompt additional alert validations.
Pagination support, unbounded list safety, and scroll indicators.
Virtualized scrolling and paging controls prevent memory leaks and browser locks on large lists.
Storekeeper allocation dispatch checklist and departure flows.
Dispatch queue allocates items to events; Mark Departed requires all storekeeper checklist items to be checked off; triggers Event Manager notification.
Read-only commission inputs, parity backend/frontend math totals.
Proposal commission fields compute values programmatically; user cannot modify calculated totals manually.
Fuel cost preview calculations, liters-per-kilometer (L/km) verification.
Trip distance logs show explicit Liters per kilometer (L/km) breakdown preview; invalid rates warn user and block logging.

Accountant imports Excel file; parser checks totals against formulas; handles unmatched events/categories.
Equipment purchases recorded by month, toggled deduction in Net Profit dashboard.

Any deployment to production or release candidate.
Record browser/device, user role, and exact page where any issue occurs.
Log in as ceo or admin. Locate the Reference Data collapsible section on the sidebar. Expand it.
You should see sub-links for Departments, Positions, Offices, Salary Levels, and Event Types.
Go to /settings/departments. Enter a new department name (e.g., "Quality Control") and click Add Department.
The department appears in the list. The field is automatically trimmed of stray spaces.
Go to /settings/positions. Edit an existing position. Change its name and save.
The position updates in the list instantly without reloading the page.
Go to /settings/offices. Add a new office (e.g., "Adama Branch"). Try to set it to Inactive.
The branch renders with a grey "Inactive" status badge. Active offices render with green "Active" badges.
Go to /settings/departments. Locate a department that is currently assigned to an active employee. Click Delete.
A pop-up warns you and blocks the deletion, displaying a message listing that active employees are using it.
Log in as driver. Try to navigate to /settings/departments or check the sidebar.
The "Reference Data" menu is hidden from the sidebar. Navigating directly redirects you to a clean Forbidden page.
Go to /events (as ops). Click Create Event. Choose a customer and input event date parameters.
The event is created in Draft state.
Go to /events/proposals as ops or ceo. Review the table/cards.
Each proposal shows its name, client, budget/margin, status, and Proposed By. Missing users show Unknown user.
Click New Proposal, fill client, budget, dates, venue, and estimate costs. Save it.
Proposal is created and appears in the queue. Detail page shows Proposed By near client/status details.
Log in as a user with approval access. Open a submitted proposal, approve it.
Status changes to Approved; detail page shows the approver when available.
Convert an approved proposal into an event.
A linked event is created, proposal status becomes Converted, and the linked event button opens the event workspace.
Open the event workspace. Locate the Employees assignment tab. Assign a staff member to a role.
Staff member is assigned. Assigning the same employee to an overlapping event date is blocked.
Locate the Vehicles & Trips area. Assign a driver and vehicle.
Trip/vehicle assignment saves; overlapping vehicle/driver use is blocked.
Add event checklist items and check them off.
Checklist progress updates and remains saved after refresh.
Delete an event if the UI allows it, then check trash/recovery area if available.
Deleted records disappear from normal lists and are only shown in trash/recovery views.
Open /events/proposals/new as ops or ceo. Set crew members and commission rate (e.g. 4 people x 3000 ETB).
Amount calculates as 12000 programmatically. Total field is read-only (disabled) and user cannot type a manual value.
Log in as driver or ops. Go to event page, select assigned truck, log a trip (12 km, 169 ETB/L).
Preview displays the calculation 12 km x 0.22 L/km = 2.64 L; 2.64 L x 169 ETB/L = ETB 446.16. Invalid fuel rate displays a warning.
ERROR - can fine the ASSIGNED TRUCK
Go to /assets. Click Add Item. Fill out asset type, serial, quantity, and assign to a warehouse store location.
The asset joins the master inventory register.
Locate the Low-Stock page. Edit an item to drop its quantity below the threshold.
The item immediately highlights in yellow with a warning badge on the Low-Stock screen.
Go to /assets/reconcile. Select a warehouse store location. Input a manual counted count.
The system audits physical count discrepancies and generates a log.
From an event workspace, allocate inventory to the event. Try allocating more than available.
Valid allocation saves; over-allocation is blocked with a clear message.
Move an asset to trash if allowed by your role.
Item disappears from active lists; restore/permanent delete actions obey permissions.
Log in as inv (Inventory Officer). Navigate to /assets/dispatch. Find an active event. Check off all allocations.
The "Mark Departed" button remains disabled until every checklist item is checked. Clicking it updates the event dispatch status.
ERROR - can do that form inv, but from ceo you can
View /assets/history with more than 10 recount sessions. Scroll/navigate pages.
Recount history lists paginate correctly and virtualized views render without lag.
Log in as inv or inventory_user. Navigate to /assets/dispatch. Observe grouped items.
Active events with active allocations are listed, grouped clearly by event, and sorted by scheduled start date (closest first).
Check all allocated items for an event in the dispatch checklist. Click Mark Departed. Log in as the Event Manager assigned to that event.
A server-side timestamp (departed_at) is written transactionally. The Event Manager receives an in-app notification immediately containing the event name and exact departure timestamp.
Check the event's activity log timeline after completing a dispatch.
Audit trail indicates who checked off each checklist line item and who completed the final dispatch, with no payroll/finance leakages.
Try to dispatch or check off items for an event that has already been closed/completed or soft-deleted.
The UI blocks checking off items, and backend APIs reject dispatch completion for locked/completed events.
Go to /hr/salary-levels. Add a base level salary rate.
Log in as acc. Open an event that has completed with verified staff attendance checks. Click Generate Labor Expense.
The system aggregates employee hours and records auto-calculated labor expenses.
ERROR - can allocate labor in the first place
Go to /hr/expenses/approve. Review pending generated or manual expenses. Approve or Reject.
Approved expenses are locked. Rejections require a reason and update status.
Go to /hr/reports/profit. View the event metrics dashboard.
The page renders financial KPIs, proposal variances, and tracks overall net profit.
Log in as driver or another non-financial user and open event pages/reports.
Financial totals, profit, payroll, and sensitive cost data are hidden or Forbidden.
Partial Error - at first i can see a sensitive data but when it reloads its not available
Log in as acc or ceo. Create or preview a payroll run.
Payroll lines show expected employees, attendance/commission data, totals, and status.
ERROR - payment must be calculated every week
Finalize a payroll run if available. Try to edit finalized values.
Finalized payroll cannot be casually changed; correction flow is required if available.
Log in as ceo. Go to /hr dashboard. Review workforce metrics and Exception Lists (Missing Bank/Contract/IDs).
Exceptions show exact flags; clicking an employee opens the quick-edit side drawer to patch data.
Log in as ceo or acc. Navigate to /hr/finance/imports. Click Import Hisab Workbook and upload a legacy .xlsx file.
A clear wizard preview loads, mapping the workbook's sheets (weekly totals, monthly expenses, investments, rental payments) to corresponding pending ERP rows.
On the import preview page, inspect sheet formulas and values.
The parser programmatically compares workbook formula totals against parsed totals, alerting the user to any discrepancy. Duplicate workbook uploads are blocked.
Look for unmatched event names, categories, or payees on the preview page.
The wizard shows warning status badges and provides dropdown selectors to map unmatched items to database entities before importing.
Click Confirm Commit to run the import.
The import executes transactionally. On failure (e.g. data validation error), the entire batch rolls back. Imported rows are tagged with source_import_id for rollback capability.
Go to /hr/finance/overheads. Add a new overhead record (e.g., Office Rent, Store Rent, Wifi, Marketing, Boost, Fuel, Ekub).
The overhead record is registered. Payroll salary lines are kept separate from non-payroll overhead lines to avoid double-counting.
Select a month in the overhead register and click Close Month. Try to edit or delete any overhead row in that month.
Row actions (edit/delete) are disabled. Any direct API updates return a clear error indicating the month is locked.
Go to /hr/finance/investments. Enter an equipment purchase or asset acquisition.
The investment is registered and categorized under capital expenditures for that month.
Go to /hr/finance/net-profit. Check the net profit card summary.
Net profit is aggregated: Event Income - Event Expenses - Non-event Operational Spend - Monthly Overheads. Toggling "Include investments in net profit" deducts Capital Investments.
Log a non-event operational expense (e.g., office lunch, misc) on the /hr/finance/hisab page.
The expense is saved and aggregates in the weekly/monthly operational expense totals.
Log in as ceo. Go to /settings/users. View users and open one user detail/edit screen.
User list loads with clear active/inactive status and role information.
Permission groups are readable; dangerous/high-access permissions are clearly shown.
Log in as a lower-permission user such as driver. Try direct URLs: /settings/users, /settings/permissions, /hr/reports/profit.
Access is denied; no hidden admin content flashes on screen.
Compare sidebar links for ceo, ops, acc, inv, and driver.
Each role sees only the modules relevant to that role.
Log out, then use the browser back button.
Protected pages do not remain usable after logout.
Log out and log in one-by-one as admin, ceo, ops, acc, eventmgr, inv, inventory_user, and driver, all with Password123.
Every documented dev/test user can log in. Role-specific sidebar and page access still match the user's role.
Go to /settings/permissions. Edit a role (e.g. check/uncheck permission slugs). Review changes pane.
Pane shows exact diff comparison of modifications before saving; dangerous changes trigger alert modals.
On /events, apply a search/filter and export if the button is available.
Export respects filters and does not include financial columns for unauthorized roles.
On /hr/reports/profit, export or print a report as ceo / acc.
File/report contains visible KPIs and event rows matching the screen.
Open a proposal detail and use Print / PDF.
Printable view is readable and excludes navigation/sidebar clutter.
Totals are readable and match the displayed payroll run.
Search by client/event name. Change page if pagination appears.
Search results match the term; pagination moves between result pages without losing filters.
Filter by status and sort by budget/date/margin.
Filters and sorting change the visible rows but do not hide Proposed By.
Search item names and switch pages.
Results remain stable and page controls are easy to use.
Open pending expense, history, and payroll list pages.
Large lists show page controls or clear limited results; no endless unbounded table freezes the browser.
Log in as ceo. Go to /events or /assets. Change the sort order, change page size to 50, filter by a status, select a specific tab. Log out, then log in again. Navigate back to the page.
The custom sort, filters, column visibility, page size, and selected tab are fully remembered and restored from the database.
On any major list page, sort by Recent or Last Edited. Edit an old record (e.g. employee details). Go back to list.
The edited record immediately moves to the top of the list, indicating updated_at (last edited time) is honored.
Log in as ops. Change filters and sorting on /events. Log out, then log in as ceo.
The ceo user's preferences are completely unchanged. Preferences are scoped strictly per-user and per-tenant.
Try saving forms with required fields empty.
Form shows clear errors and does not create partial records.
Try an event/proposal end date before the start date.
Save is blocked with a clear date error.
Enter an obviously invalid Ethiopian phone number.
Save is blocked or phone field shows a clear error.
Only one record/action is created; no duplicate conversion or duplicate expense appears.
Open proposal records created by a deleted/missing user if test data exists.
UI shows Unknown user, not a crash or blank broken field.
Perform any database save or delete operation.
A premium toast notification pops up indicating success/failure with brand-appropriate design.
Create or Update an asset, employee, or event. Locate and click the Activity Timeline or Audit button.
A side drawer opens to reveal user actions, timestamps, and field-level changes.
Log in as ceo or admin. Go to /settings/security.
Shows traffic-light security posture cards, plain language access overview, database indicators, and no raw jargon.
Simulate offline connection using Chrome devtools. Load the site.
The PWA install bottom sheet prompt displays correctly; offline mode opens the offline fallback shell showing a friendly offline warning.
Go to /events/trash or /assets/trash. Trash an active item, then click Restore.
Soft deleted items appear in the trash queue; clicking restore returns them to active tables; permanent deletion destroys them.
Go to /employees or /assets. Click Clone / Duplicate.
Cloned record duplicates field data (names, classifications, details) and images dynamically.
Open an event workspace, a payroll run details page, and finance records pages.
Each page contains a visible Activity / Audit button to launch the history timeline drawer.
Log in as driver or eventmgr (roles without finance permissions). Open the activity log for any shared event or record.
Financial changes, cost updates, commission rate edits, and payroll values in the timeline notes/fields are redacted or completely hidden.
Log in, toggle system/app to Light Mode. Go to /hr/expenses/approve.
The table header row has a high-contrast dark text color; background panels for "Pending Queue", "History", and "Receipt" cards are clean and readable.
View any button or link with a gold background in light/dark modes.
Text/icons on gold buttons use a compliant high-contrast color (e.g., white or very dark primary foreground). No low-contrast amber text combinations.
Audit date pickers, buttons, input fields, and receipt cards.
The UI uses unified luxury radius variables (dl-radius-lg / dl-radius-xl representing --radius-## tokens). No default Bootstrap or hardcoded rounded-lg / rounded-xl classes are present in the DOM.
Go to /events/proposals/new. Leave required fields empty (e.g., Estimate Label) and click Submit.
Validation fails: focus is automatically returned to the form, and the exact missing inputs are outlined in high-visibility warning red.
View proposal detail or new proposal screens on a screen resized to 320px wide.
Action buttons (< Back, Create Draft, Submit For Approval) scale/stack cleanly without overlapping or text clipping. Touch target sizes are at least 48px.
Submit a proposal or edit a record. Watch the submit button.
The button shows a clean, non-intrusive loading spinner or state, indicating background work without locking accessibility.
Log in as ops. Navigate to /events/proposals/new.
Enter a client name, venue, start/end dates, and description.
Set up commission rates: allocate 4 crew members and set a rate of 3000 ETB. Verify the commission total automatically calculates to 12000 ETB and that the field is read-only (disabled).
Intentionally leave Estimate Label blank and click Submit. Confirm the page blocks submission, shifts focus to the empty field, and highlights it in red.
Correct the estimate, submit for approval, and watch the submit loading spinner.
Click the Duplicate / Clone button on the newly created proposal. Verify the duplicate form initializes with matching data.
Log in as ceo. Navigate to /events/proposals.
Locate the proposal and open it. Click Approve.
Click Convert to Event. Verify the linked event is successfully created and proposal status switches to Converted.
Go to /events and open the converted event's workspace.
Select the Vehicles & Trips tab. Assign driver and a truck.
Log a trip of 12 km at 169 ETB/L. Verify the distance log outputs: 12 km x 0.22 L/km = 2.64 L; 2.64 L x 169 ETB/L = ETB 446.16.
Log a trip with a blank or negative fuel rate and verify a warning badge displays.
Log in as inv. Navigate to /assets.
Click Add Item. Register a new asset (e.g. "Luxury Chandelier") with serial, color, unit, and location.
Go to /assets/reconcile, select the store location, and perform a recount.
Check /assets/history with pagination to verify recount records are logged.
Click Clone / Duplicate on the asset to verify the clone workflow works.
Log in as ops. Go to the event workspace created in Story 1.
Allocate 5 of the new "Luxury Chandelier" items to the event. Try allocating 50 (exceeding stock) and verify it shows an "Insufficient Stock" error.
Log in as inv or inventory_user. Go to /assets/dispatch.
Verify the event is listed in the dispatch queue, grouped by event and sorted by date.
Open the event's dispatch detail checklist.
Try clicking Mark Departed before checking any items off. Confirm the button is disabled.
Check off all allocations one by one. The Mark Departed button is now enabled. Click it. Verify the success toast.
Log in as the eventmgr assigned to the event.
Look at the top navbar notifications count. Open notifications.
Verify a new message: "Event [Name] has departed at [timestamp]". Click it to navigate directly to the event page.
Log in as driver. Open the event's workspace and open the Activity Timeline. Confirm you see dispatch checklist updates, but all financial details are redacted.
Log in as ceo. Open the same timeline and verify you see full, unredacted financial notes.
Log in as acc. Navigate to /hr/finance/imports.
Click Import Hisab Workbook and upload the sample .xlsx file.
Observe the mapping preview cards matching the four sheets of the workbook.
Look for a red formula mismatch warning. If present, double-check parsed values against totals.
Select the dropdown mappings to resolve any unmatched event names or categories.
Confirm and import. Verify the new rows are labeled with a shared source_import_id.
Navigate to /hr/finance/overheads. Add a new monthly overhead item (e.g. Office Rent, 25000 ETB, scope: Office, recur: True).
Go to /hr/finance/investments and add a capital asset purchase (e.g. Generator, 120000 ETB).
Go back to /hr/finance/overheads, select the current month, and click Close Month / Approve Month.
Try editing or deleting any overhead row in the closed month. Verify row actions are disabled.
Log in as ceo. Go to /hr/finance/net-profit.
Verify the net profit dashboard correctly aggregates: Event Income - Event Expenses - Non-event Operational Spend - Overheads.
Toggle the checkbox "Include investments in net profit" and check if the Generator investment is subtracted or excluded from the net profit value.
As ceo on the overheads page, change sorting, filter by a payee, and change the tab.
Log out, then log in again. Navigate back to the overheads page. Verify the sorting, filter, and tab are restored.
Log in as driver. Navigate to /hr/finance/overheads. Verify you are redirected to a Forbidden page.
Log in as ceo. Navigate to the /hr dashboard.
Look at the Exception Lists (Missing Bank Accounts, Contracts, etc.).
Click on an employee from the exception list. A quick-edit side drawer opens.
Fill in the missing bank detail fields, and click Save. Check that they are cleared from the exception list.
Log in as acc. Create a payroll run. Verify base salary levels and completed event commissions populate.
Click the activity timeline icon on the payroll run. Verify creation actions are logged.
